mapper.select: WITH live AS ( SELECT e.id, e.canonical_name, e.description, e.created_at, btrim(regexp_replace(e.specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS spelling, lower(btrim(regexp_replace(e.specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) AS kind_word FROM entities e WHERE e.kb_id = #{kbId} AND e.merged_into IS NULL AND e.specific_type IS NOT NULL AND btrim(e.specific_type) <> '' ), grouped AS ( SELECT kind_word, count(*) AS count, (array_agg(canonical_name ORDER BY (description IS NOT NULL), created_at, id))[1:3] AS examples FROM live GROUP BY kind_word ), spellings AS ( SELECT kind_word, spelling, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY kind_word ORDER BY count(*) DESC, spelling) AS rn FROM live GROUP BY kind_word, spelling ), words AS ( SELECT kind_word, array_agg(spelling ORDER BY rn) AS words FROM spellings WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY kind_word ), phrase_counts AS ( SELECT l.kind_word, f.phrase, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.kind_word ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.phrase) AS rn FROM facts f JOIN live l ON l.id = f.subject_id WHERE f.kb_id = #{kbId} AND f.layer = 'open' AND f.invalidated_at IS NULL AND f.phrase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.kind_word, f.phrase ), phrases AS ( SELECT kind_word, array_agg(phrase ORDER BY rn) AS phrases FROM phrase_counts WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY kind_word ) SELECT g.kind_word, g.count, coalesce(w.words, '{}') AS words, g.examples, coalesce(p.phrases, '{}') AS phrases FROM grouped g LEFT JOIN words w ON w.kind_word = g.kind_word LEFT JOIN phrases p ON p.kind_word = g.kind_word ORDER BY g.count DESC, g.kind_word
SELECT kind_word, type_id, status, decided_at, decided_by, basis FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} ORDER BY kind_word

SELECT b.kind_word FROM type_bindings b LEFT JOIN entity_types t ON t.id = b.type_id WHERE b.kb_id = #{kbId} AND ((b.status = 'bound' AND t.updated_at > b.decided_at) OR (b.status IN ('none', 'undecided') AND b.decided_at < (SELECT max(updated_at) FROM entity_types WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}))) ORDER BY b.kind_word
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO type_bindings (id, kb_id, kind_word, words, type_id, status, votes, decided_at, decided_by, basis) VALUES (#{id}, #{kbId}, #{kindWord}, #{words,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.TextArrayTypeHandler}, #{typeId}, #{status}, #{votes,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, now(), #{decidedBy}, #{basis}) ON CONFLICT (kb_id, kind_word) DO UPDATE SET words = CASE WHEN cardinality(EXCLUDED.words) = 0 THEN type_bindings.words ELSE EXCLUDED.words END, type_id = EXCLUDED.type_id, status = EXCLUDED.status, votes = EXCLUDED.votes, decided_at = now(), decided_by = EXCLUDED.decided_by, basis = EXCLUDED.basis WHERE NOT (type_bindings.decided_by = 'person' AND EXCLUDED.decided_by = 'agent')
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET type_id = NULL, type_source = 'extracted', updated_at = now() WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND merged_into IS NULL AND type_source = 'aligned' AND specific_type IS NOT NULL AND lower(btrim(regexp_replace(specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = #{kindWord}
mapper.select: SELECT kind_word, type_id FROM type_bindings WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND status = 'bound' AND type_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE entities SET proposed_type = left(#{spelling}, 60) WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND merged_into IS NULL AND type_id IS NULL AND type_source <> 'human' AND proposed_type IS NULL AND specific_type IS NOT NULL AND lower(btrim(regexp_replace(specific_type, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))) = #{kindWord}
